summary.goal: Build the dashboard page showing project list, AI overview, and first-time experience.

acceptance_criteria.description: Right column shows project list as text-based tree with attention indicators
Center column has AI conversation for discussing priorities and next actions
Left column collapses when empty (no forming blocks at dashboard level)
Each project entry shows: name, step progress (e.g., '7/10 · 3 running'), attention signals (e.g., '⟳ Session middleware · needs input')
[+ new] button or conversational creation starts new project
First-time experience: empty state with warm AI greeting ('What would you like to work on?')
Sections hidden when empty (WORK, ARTIFACTS in right column appear only when content exists)

observations: The dashboard uses the same three-column layout as the project page — this is a tend principle
The content changes: left has project drafts (future: cultivate signals), center has AI overview, right has project list
ideation-ui already has a DashboardPage with session list — adapt the structure, replace session list with project list
The empty state aesthetic should feel like a zen garden: peaceful, ready, full of potential
Project list is text-based, not cards — matches the tend aesthetic
Attention indicators use symbols (⟳ for needs attention, • for running, ✓ for done)
questions: Should the dashboard conversation context include all projects or be global/meta?
Do we show archived projects or only active?
Should project creation always be conversational or allow quick-add?

steps.title: Adapt ideation-ui DashboardPage to tend
steps.description: Copy packages/ideation-ui/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx structure. Replace with TendLayout (same three-column grid). Keep layout structure, replace session-specific content with project-specific. Route: / → DashboardPage.

steps.title: Create project list component
steps.description: Create ProjectListColumn component. Render text-based list (not cards) of projects from GET /api/projects. Each entry: project name, step progress ('7/10 · 3 running' — calculate from plan steps), attention signals (⟳ needs input, • running, ✓ done, ✗ failed). Use attention symbols from context. Click project → navigate to /projects/:id.

steps.title: Wire center column conversation
steps.description: Copy ConversationPane from packages/planner-ui or packages/ideation-ui. At dashboard level, conversation is global/meta (discusses priorities, next actions across projects). Reuses same chat UI components (ChatInput, ChatMessageList, ChatBubble). Connects to TendInterviewerService on #dashboard channel (or global).

steps.title: Left column behavior at dashboard level
steps.description: At dashboard level, left column shows project drafts (forming projects before graduation) OR collapses when empty. Copy collapsible column pattern from ideation-ui NowColumn. Future: cultivate signals showing projects needing attention. Empty state: collapsed with subtle hint text.

steps.title: Implement project creation
steps.description: Add [+ new] button in project list (right column header). Click → opens conversational creation flow in center column OR quick-create modal. POST /api/projects creates project + linked session + plan. After creation, navigate to /projects/:id or stay at dashboard showing new project in list.

steps.title: Implement empty states
steps.description: Copy empty state pattern from implementation doc. First-time greeting in center column: 'What would you like to work on? I can help you explore an idea, plan a feature, or jump into building.' Zen garden aesthetic: peaceful, warm, inviting. Left column collapsed. Right column shows only [+ new] button. WORK and ARTIFACTS sections in right column hidden when no projects exist.

architect.project_list_style: text-based with attention indicators, not cards
architect.empty_state: zen garden aesthetic, warm AI greeting

sections.left: project drafts (future: cultivate signals), collapses when empty
sections.center: AI conversation for priorities and meta-discussion
sections.right: project list with WORK and ARTIFACTS sections
